app.title: A 386 PC for Your RP2350
app.author: SamuraiLion
app.description: Open‑source PCB and firmware design to create a 386‑class PC that runs on the Raspberry Pi RP2350 microcontroller, including a custom BIOS and bootloader.
proposed_tests: Download and flash the firmware onto an RP2350 board
Verify that the system boots and displays the BIOS splash screen
Run the built‑in BIOS diagnostics to check CPU, memory, and I/O
Load a simple COM program from a disk image and confirm execution
Measure boot time from power‑on to ready state
